WITH ordered AS ( SELECT q.QNA_NO AS qnaNo, q.QNA_TITLE AS qnaTitle, q.USER_ID AS userId,
u.USER_NAME AS writerName, u.ROLE AS writerRole,
q.QNA_STATUS AS qnaStatus, q.IS_NOTICE AS isNotice,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER( ORDER BY DECODE(q.IS_NOTICE, 'Y', 1, 0) DESC, q.QNA_CREATED DESC, q.QNA_NO DESC ) AS rn FROM QNA_BOARD q JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_ID = q.USER_ID WHERE NVL(q.DEL_YN,'N') = 'N' ) SELECT qnaNo, qnaTitle, userId, writerName, writerRole, qnaStatus, isNotice FROM ordered WHERE rn = (SELECT rn - 1 FROM ordered WHERE qnaNo = #{value})
